title: The Last Pour at Ashmere
setting: Ashmere Distillery, a fog-bound family whisky house on the north coast, the night before the fifty-year cask auction
public_setup: Halloran Ashmere was found in his own barrel cellar at dawn, beneath a toppled cask, twelve hours before the auction that was meant to save the family business. The coroner called it an accident. The staff did not.
timeline: 21:40 - Auction appraiser Tovah Blythe finishes cataloguing the fifty-year casks and retires to the tasting room.
23:15 - Halloran is heard arguing with someone in the still house. Words indistinct.
00:20 - Odile Fen, cellar hand, claims she went to bed. She did not.
00:35 - A single heavy impact is heard from the barrel cellar.
01:10 - Rennick Ashmere is seen washing his hands at the still house sink.
06:00 - Halloran found beneath cask 47. Cask 47 is empty and weighs almost nothing.

rooms.name: The Barrel Cellar
rooms.image_prompt: A dim stone whisky cellar, rows of oak casks stacked three high, one toppled and split on the flagstones, cold blue dawn light through a high grated window, chalk marks on the barrel heads, moody noir lighting

rooms.name: The Still House
rooms.image_prompt: A cramped Victorian still house at night, enormous copper pot still dominating the room, brass tools on a wall rack with one empty hook, steam and low amber lamplight, wet stone floor

rooms.name: The Tasting Room
rooms.image_prompt: An oak-panelled whisky tasting room, long table with numbered sample glasses, auction catalogue open, tall shuttered windows, green banker's lamp, empty chairs, quiet and expensive

npcs.name: Odile Fen
npcs.role: Cellar hand and apprentice distiller, twenty-three, worked here since she was fifteen
knowledge: Halloran taught her everything and treated her better than his own brother did
She was awake past midnight and did not go to bed when she claims she did
Casks in the north aisle have sounded hollow for months
secrets: She saw Rennick come out of the barrel cellar at around half past midnight, carrying something wrapped in sacking
She said nothing because Rennick controls whether she keeps her job

npcs.name: Rennick Ashmere
npcs.role: The victim's younger brother, business manager of the distillery, forty-eight
knowledge: He handled every contract and every buyer for the last nine years
He says he was asleep by eleven
He resented being the one who did paperwork while Halloran got the credit
secrets: He is personally in debt to the tune of eleven thousand
He quietly sold the fifty-year casks to a private buyer two years ago and refilled the barrels with cheap spirit
Halloran discovered the empty casks the night he died

npcs.name: Tovah Blythe
npcs.role: Auction house appraiser, staying overnight to catalogue the fifty-year casks
knowledge: She has appraised four hundred distilleries and knows the weight of a full cask by feel
She heard raised voices from the still house around quarter past eleven
She has no personal stake in this family
secrets: The manifest she was given had been amended in a second hand, altering cask numbers
She had already decided to flag the sale as fraudulent before Halloran died

clues.name: The Ledger Doesn't Balance
clues.text: The cellar ledger logs cask 47 as full at 512 litres. The cask that crushed Halloran was light enough for one man to tip over.
clues.unlock_hint: Examining the cellar ledger and comparing the recorded weights against the toppled cask.

clues.name: Odile Was Awake
clues.text: Odile admits she was not in bed at midnight. She saw Rennick leave the barrel cellar at around 00:30, carrying something wrapped in sacking.
clues.unlock_hint: Pressing Odile about where she really was that night, or accusing her of lying.

clues.name: The Missing Mallet
clues.text: The brass tool rack has eleven hooks and ten tools. The empty hook is outlined in nine years of dust, and the outline is the shape of a cask mallet.
clues.unlock_hint: Examining the brass tool rack in the still house.

clues.name: Rennick's Debt
clues.text: Rennick owes eleven thousand to a private lender. He admits the auction was the only thing standing between him and ruin.
clues.unlock_hint: Asking Rennick about money, debt, the auction, or who benefits financially from the sale.

clues.name: The Amended Manifest
clues.text: Tovah confirms the auction manifest was altered in a second hand. The fifty-year casks were sold to a private buyer two years ago. What was in the cellar was cheap spirit in old barrels.
clues.unlock_hint: Asking Tovah about the manifest, the paperwork, the cask inventory, or her professional opinion of the sale.

motive_options: to conceal that he had secretly sold the fifty-year casks and refilled them with cheap spirit
to settle a long-running dispute over who would inherit the distillery
to silence a witness to an affair
out of revenge for being kept from the master distiller's role

solution.motive: to conceal that he had secretly sold the fifty-year casks and refilled them with cheap spirit
